title: Turkish 'i' uppercase/lowercase conversion bug breaking keys and enums
symptoms: String enum parsing or JSON key lookup fails on Turkish locale devices
String.ToUpper() produces 'İTEM_İD' instead of 'ITEM_ID', breaking dictionary lookups
causes: Using `str.ToUpper()` or `str.ToLower()` without CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, transforming `i->İ` on Turkish locales

solution.action: Always use `ToUpperInvariant()` or `StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase` for internal IDs, JSON keys, and Enum parsing.
Apply culture-specific casing only when rendering text to user interface.

prevention: Run unit tests with current culture set to `tr-TR`.
